notes.title: STEAM CURATORS Part 2
notes.content:
Hi Everyone ! 

I have received more request for review codes. 

1) Please understand that I can only send 1 (in some cases 2) to each reviewer. 

2) I need to evaluate STEAM CURATOR's page and social media information so that I make sure more fans and followers are able to see the review and nothing inappropriate is being posted on the pages.

3) I cannot send review codes to STEAM CURATORS that review inappropriate content (hentai games, etc) because I personally do not think it is in CIRCLE / FHW's best interest to be associated with that content. We do not publish that genre / those kinds of games. 

I hope this makes sense and thank you so much for understanding. 

Thank you so much for your support and interests ! 

Have a great day !

- BOSSCAT
